name: Will o' Wisp ~Easter no Kiseki~
original_name: ウィル・オ・ウィスプ ～イースターの奇跡～
source:
A fandisc set one year after the events of Will o' Wisp.
Hanna was working everyday with all her might as a novice doll-maker, but sometimes she was tormented with feelings of loneliness.
"I want to meet everybody one more time!"
When that wish left her lips, a miracle occurred.
The time frame is one week, how will Hanna spend it...?

[Translated from [url=http://www37.atwiki.jp/girlgame/pages/500.html]Girl Game Wiki[/url]]
